name: irregular-separated
description: An asymmetric solid chosen for printing: mixed valences (3, 4, 5) and face sizes (3, 4, 5), with no two R2 features closer than 24.7 degrees. It replaces irregular-mixed as the printable "any convex solid". irregular-mixed has two adjacent faces 3.4 degrees from coplanar, whose R2 poles fuse into one double spike. The points come from a seeded search (`IRREGULAR_SEPARATED_POINTS`).
